enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Strength +4: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +4 Insight bonus to Strength.
Attack Bonus +10: Provides a +10 competence bonus to your attack rolls.
Greater Heroism: Passive: +4 morale bonus to all your attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks. Does not grant immunity to Fear.
Epic Captain's Set: While wearing both items from the Epic Captain's Set, you gain: +2 Quality bonus to Strength
Epic The Devil's Handiwork: While wearing any five items from the Epic The Devil's Handiwork, you gain: +3 Quality bonus to all Ability stats
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
